stem: How does this quotation support the main idea of the article?
instruction:
Use “Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age” to answer the following question.

Read this quotation from paragraph 5 of the article “Paper Calendars Endure Despite the Digital Age.”

"The consumer can customize a planner to fit his or her style with accessories, colors and even color code events and activities," she wrote.

options.label: A
options.text: It shows that people’s purchasing behaviors are unpredictable.

options.label: B
options.text: It argues that consumers should buy a particular type of planner.

options.label: C
options.text: It provides specific reasons why paper planners remain popular.

options.label: D
options.text: It explains why people confuse planners with calendars.

visual_elements: "The consumer can customize a planner to fit his or her style with accessories, colors and even color code events and activities," she wrote.
